title: AA battery holder
about: A block that holds four AA batteries standing up, in 15 mm round pockets, 15 mm deep. One pocket is drawn and cut; a pattern repeats it along the block every 16 mm.
picture_alt: A block with four round pockets in a row, for AA batteries
